title: Bind trust-store key rotation signatures to the replacement key and domain
description: SECURITY: python/src/lichen/crypto/trust.py::TrustStore.rotate_key verifies old_pubkey over arbitrary caller-supplied rotation_message, then installs independently supplied new_pubkey without checking that the signed transcript contains that key, the old identity, or a rotation domain/version. Any previously valid Schnorr48 signature by the old key can be replayed as authorization for an attacker-chosen replacement key if it reaches this API. Define a canonical domain-separated transcript committing to old pubkey/IID, exact new pubkey, version/context, and replay nonce/sequence; construct it internally rather than accepting arbitrary bytes; persist anti-replay state and add substitution/cross-protocol/replay vectors.
close_reason: Fixed: rotate_key now uses canonical domain-separated transcript computed internally via compute_rotation_transcript(). Signature binds to old_pubkey, new_pubkey, and rotation_sequence. Monotonic anti-replay check (rotation_sequence > stored) prevents replay attacks. TrustEntry gains rotation_sequence field, persisted via TrustStorePersistence. Added tests for sequence replay, wrong transcript keys. All 92 tests pass, ruff clean.
